More About Me

Birth Doula Support

What a doula does

A doula is a trained, non-medical companion who supports you — and the people who love you — before, during and shortly after birth.

Emotional support

A calm, continuous presence who listens without judgement, eases worries, and helps you feel safe and cared for throughout your journey.

Physical comfort

Gentle, practical comfort measures during labour — position changes, counter-pressure, breathing and relaxation techniques, and a soothing environment.

Information & advocacy

Clear information to help you understand your options, prepare questions for your care team, and make decisions that feel right for your family.

Why Choose Linda

Support that feels like family

Choosing a doula is a personal decision. Here's the approach Linda brings to every family she supports.

01

A calm, steady presence

Birth can feel unpredictable. Linda offers a grounded, reassuring presence that helps the whole room breathe a little easier.

02

Your choices, respected

There is no single "right" way to give birth. Linda supports your preferences — whatever they are — without judgement or agenda.

03

Support for partners, too

Partners are part of the journey. Linda helps them feel confident and involved, so they can support you in the ways that matter most.

04

Continuity of care

One familiar, trusted person alongside you from pregnancy through birth — someone who knows your wishes and your story.

About Me

Meet Linda

Supporting mothers through pregnancy and birth is work close to Linda's heart — a calling rooted in the belief that how a woman is cared for during birth stays with her for a lifetime.

Linda's story, in her own words, will be shared here — how she came to doula work, the births and families that shaped her, and what she loves most about walking beside expecting parents.

My philosophy

Birth is not something to be managed from the sidelines — it is an experience to be honoured. Linda's approach is simple: listen first, support gently, and protect the calm, respectful space every mother deserves. She works alongside your chosen care team, helping you feel informed and empowered to make the decisions that are right for you and your baby.

Training & background: To be confirmed by Linda May Doula Services. Linda's qualifications, certifications and experience will be listed here once confirmed.

The values behind the care

Four simple promises guide every family Linda supports.

Compassion

Warm, heartfelt care that meets you exactly where you are — in joy, in uncertainty, and in every moment in between.

Empowerment

Information and encouragement that help you trust your instincts and step into birth feeling capable and confident.

Respect

Your body, your baby, your choices. Linda honours your preferences, your culture and your birth wishes, always.

Understanding

Every family's story is different. Linda takes time to truly listen, so the support you receive feels personal — never one-size-fits-all.

Services

How Linda can support you

Each family's needs are different. Explore the support available below, then reach out for a consultation to talk through what would serve you best. Package details and pricing are to be confirmed by Linda May Doula Services.

Pregnancy Support

The months before birth are full of anticipation — and questions. Pregnancy support gives you a trusted person to turn to as you prepare: someone to talk through how you're feeling, help you prepare questions for your care providers, and gently guide you as your due date approaches.

  • Regular check-ins and a listening ear throughout your pregnancy
  • Help preparing questions for midwife or physician appointments
  • Guidance on comfort, rest and preparing your home and heart
  • Support for partners and family members, too

Full details of this support are to be confirmed by Linda May Doula Services.

Birth & Labour Support

When labour begins, Linda is by your side — a continuous, calming presence from the first contractions until your baby is in your arms. She offers hands-on comfort, quiet encouragement, and steady support for your partner, so you can focus on the work of bringing your baby earthside.

  • Continuous in-person support throughout labour and birth
  • Comfort measures — positioning, counter-pressure, breath and relaxation
  • A calm environment and gentle advocacy for your birth preferences
  • Reassurance and guidance for your partner throughout

Full details of this support are to be confirmed by Linda May Doula Services.

Postpartum Support To be confirmed

The first days and weeks at home are beautiful — and tender. Postpartum support is designed to help you rest, recover and settle into life with your newborn, with a caring extra pair of hands and a listening ear.

  • Gentle in-home support as you recover and rest
  • Reassurance with feeding, soothing and newborn care basics
  • Time and space for you to shower, nap and recharge
  • Emotional support as you adjust to new parenthood

This service is to be confirmed — whether it is offered, and its full details, will be confirmed by Linda May Doula Services.

Birth Preparation & Planning To be confirmed

Feeling prepared can transform how you approach birth. Preparation and planning sessions offer unhurried time to explore your options, talk through your preferences, and create a birth plan that truly reflects your wishes.

  • One-to-one sessions to explore your birth preferences
  • Help creating a clear, thoughtful birth plan
  • Conversations about comfort measures and coping strategies
  • Space for partners to prepare alongside you

This service is to be confirmed — whether it is offered, and its full details, will be confirmed by Linda May Doula Services.
